- Build a complete, playable “Clicker de upgrades” game in the repository.

- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport at most 1280px wide, and read only the latest screenshot.

- Implemented a Portuguese-language incremental energy clicker as a standalone HTML game.
- Added a dark responsive interface, upgrades, passive production, persistence/offline earnings, milestones, sound toggle, and prestige.

- Created the playable game in `index.html`.
- Verified JavaScript syntax and tested clicking, purchasing upgrades, and passive production in Chromium.
